facts.fact: Full submit-review wizard flow as documented and implemented: entry = getcodepage (版本管理) page, find the target version row by own-text-node match on the version string (e.g. '0.9.12'), walk up max 8 parent levels to the row containing a `button.weui-desktop-btn_primary` (提交审核), click it inline -> 第1步 须知弹窗 (checkbox two-stage eval + 下一步) -> 第2步 安全测试提醒弹窗 (继续提交) -> 第3步 主表单整页, reached when URL contains `get_class?action=get_class` -> submit button is `<a class="btn btn_primary">` (NOT `<button>`) -> 终验 keywords 已提交审核/提交成功/审核中 in body + version page shows 审核版本 X · 审核中 · timestamp. After submit, a success dialog with 「确定」 appears in the get_class tab; finish step clicks it, reloads getcodepage and verifies the version row shows 审核中.

submit_review_0911.py (misnamed for 0.9.11, actually drives 0.9.12: VER = "0.9.12") implements 4 stages only: `recon` (zero-click: appid check + live 体验版 version read + target row dump + dialog dump + screenshot), `open` (click 提交审核 -> 须知 dialog appears, no checkbox), `step1` (check checkbox in one eval, verify cb.checked in a separate eval, click 下一步 via own-text-node), `step2` (click 继续提交 -> sleep 5 -> dump visible textareas with placeholder/length + radios with name/value/label-text/checked + `urlHasGetClass` flag). The docstring documents `fill` (版本描述 + 单选三件 + 加急, stop before submit) and `submit` stages, but the code prints `UNKNOWN_STAGE` and exits 1 for them — fill/submit were executed via wizard_run.py-style stages instead (filing shots wz_fill/wz_commit exist for the 0.9.0 submit at 19:21:48/19:22:10 and wz_* chain reused for later submits).

wizard_run.py (0.9.0 one-piece wizard, 1008 实况) stage chain: `nav` (getcodepage, dump `.code_version_log` blocks), `step1` (click 提交审核 inside the version block, then click checkbox), `step1b` (re-verify checkbox checked==true else hard exit, then click 下一步), `step2` (click 继续提交, print new URL), `form` (dump textareas incl. val_head/maxLength, radios, and 订单中心 label context), `fill` (native-setter fill of VERSION_DESC), `commit` (pre-commit snapshot of desc_len + checked radios, then scrollIntoView + click `a.btn_primary` with text 提交审核 in a separate eval, then terminal-keyword check). Iron rules in docstring: 自有文本节点找真按钮; checkbox 勾后必复验; 每步回读 DOM.

未成年人问卷 (minor-protection questionnaire) as a wizard step is NOT documented in any file under E:/AI-Station/WeAppForge or the skill references — greps for 未成年人/问卷 only hit privacy-policy WXML/agreement copy, not the wizard. The documented wizard is strictly: 须知 -> 安全测试提醒 -> get_class 主表单 -> 提交 -> 成功弹窗确定. The claimed questionnaire step is unverifiable from files on disk.

The main submit form opens in a NEW tab whose URL contains `get_class` (the original getcodepage tab stays open). wizard_run.py pins the tab at startup: iterate page.tab_ids, prefer any tab whose URL contains 'get_class', else the 'wacodepage/getcodepage' tab. finish_review_0912.py separates the two: `gc` = first tab with get_class (holds the success dialog), `codepage` = first tab with getcodepage (holds version rows). submit_review_0911.py reuses the EXISTING getcodepage tab across fill/submit stages so the wizard advances in the same tab (creates a new one via page.new_tab(getcodepage?token=...&lang=zh_CN) + sleep 6 only if absent).

Zombie-tab cold-load: in watch_review_browser.py, after `location.reload()` + sleep 9, if the JS read returns NO_ROW and `hasBody` is false (body.innerText length <= 200, i.e. page not rendered), the script sleeps 5 more seconds and re-runs the same read once — comment: 首次 reload 未渲染完（僵尸标签冷加载慢）→ 再读一轮.

Exact Vue-controlled textarea fill recipe (wizard_run.py fill stage): locate real textarea by `(placeholder contains '功能') || value.length > 20 || maxLength === 200` (fallback first textarea); then `var setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(ta, desc); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true}));` — return `{found, len: ta.value.length, head, tail}` as fill evidence. The Chinese text is passed safely by URL-encoding in Python (`urllib.parse.quote`) and `decodeURIComponent(...)` inside the JS.

吃进判据 (accepted-proof): the counter text (e.g. `184/200` from `.counter,.text-counter,.textarea-counter`) must equal the read-back `ta.value.length` — mismatch means Vue never consumed the value, refill required. Hidden JSON draft slot trap: pages hide a JSON-slot textarea; `querySelector('textarea')` first match can hit it — anchor the real one by its placeholder text (ICP-filing form used placeholder containing '请根据实际情况填写').

加急 (expedited review) reality per files: (1) mp-console-automation.md — 审核加急 = 只能在此处选（提交时），提交后无法改（免费加急额度在此用）; (2) mp-compliance-gates.md form table — 加急 | 只能在提交时选，过后不可补 | 默认不加急; (3) submit_audit_api.py API path — 提交审核（常规审核，绝不加急）, i.e. the API resubmit deliberately never expends quota; (4) e2e-harness-recipes.md terminal-check table records 不加急 as one of the six form items.

get_latest_auditstatus is a THIRD-PARTY-PLATFORM-ONLY endpoint: a self-developed miniprogram calling it with its own client_credential token gets `errcode 86000 "should be called only from third party"` (2026-10-02 实测). The endpoint is GET-only (POST returns 43001). Consequence: self-developed accounts have NO login-free API to read audit status — the only channels are (1) 管理员手机推送 via 微信「公众平台安全助手」 and (2) the console UI version-management page, which is what watch_review_browser.py reads (getcodepage tab reload -> find target version row -> classify status words).

Browser-leg watcher never cold-starts Chrome: `port_alive(9336)` = `socket.socket(); s.settimeout(1.5); s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", 9336)) == 0`; if the port is down (e.g. after machine reboot) it prints `{"verdict": "SKIP", "detail": "9336 not running"}` and exits 0 silently. When alive it attaches with DrissionPage `ChromiumOptions().set_local_port(9336)` — comment: 只 attach，绝不带 profile 冷启动. SKIP/PENDING/ERROR/AUTH_EXPIRED are all silent; only APPROVED/REJECTED flips notify.

Row classification keywords (watch_review_browser.py `classify`): APPROVED if row contains any of 审核通过/已发布/线上版本; REJECTED if any of 审核不通过/驳回/审核失败; else PENDING (审核中/已提交审核 流转态). AUTH_EXPIRED if body.innerText contains 登录超时 or 扫码登录. Target version pinned by constant WATCH_VER = "0.9.12"; row found via own-text-node match then walk up max 8 parents requiring 10 < len < 600 and containing the version string.

facts.fact: watch_category_api.py (1007 持久化改造，零登录免扫码): GET https://api.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/token?grant_type=client_credential&appid=&secret= (secret parsed from E:/AI-Station/data/secrets/zongbao_qianwen_mp.secret, key=value lines) then GET https://api.weixin.qq.com/wxa/get_category?access_token=... — the official endpoint returns ONLY approved-and-effective categories, so TARGET=("深度合成","AI问答") present in category_list = GREEN, absent = PENDING (审核中 or 驳回 — no login needed to distinguish, since GREEN is the only action-triggering state). Baseline sanity: BASELINE={("工具","信息查询"),("资讯","信息资讯")} must be a subset of live (baseline_ok); missing baseline = anomaly suggesting 注销冻结/审核变动 (browser recheck advised). 1007 browser cross-check confirmed the semantics: browser showed 深度合成>AI问答 审核中 while API returned only the two baseline categories.

curl_cffi trap on the API domain: curl_cffi with `impersonate` against api.weixin.qq.com gets TLS-killed (SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL); plain `requests` direct connection works — watch_category_api.py and submit_audit_api.py both mandate plain requests (submit_audit_api.py header: 纯 requests（curl_cffi 对 api.weixin.qq.com TLS 必断）).

submit_audit_api.py = category-green re-submit path (0.7.7 原包): preconditions BOOT-SIM v3 247/247 全绿 + /wxa/get_category 实证 深度合成/AI问答 APPROVED (also gated by state flag mp_category_green.flag existing); flow = GET /wxa/get_latest_auditstatus (confirm no in-flight audit + last failure reason) then POST /wxa/security/submit_audit with item_list of 7 pages mapped to approved categories: pages/ask/ask + pages/answer/answer + pages/pot/pot -> 深度合成/AI问答; pages/zhiku/zhiku -> 资讯/信息资讯; pages/my/my + pages/home/home + pages/legal/privacy -> 工具/信息查询; each item {address, tag, first_class, second_class, third_class:"", title}; plus feedback_info. 错号灾难防线 (wrong-account disaster guard) in submit_review_0911.py: before ANY stage action, the getcodepage tab's HTML must contain APPID (wx5cee1574ce45819b); if absent it prints `APPID_MISMATCH（错号灾难防线）: 页面无 <appid>` and exits 1. Login detection: any tab whose URL contains mp.weixin.qq.com AND token=; token extracted with regex `token=(\d{8,})`.

Checkbox iron rule (mp-console-automation.md §3, implemented in submit_review_0911.py step1 / wizard_run.py step1b): clicking a matched input[type=checkbox] whose label is also bound toggles twice if looped — click EXACTLY once in one eval, then in a SEPARATE eval read `.checked` and require true; checkbox-click and 下一步-click must also be two independent evals (same-eval chaining = Vue digest miss, second click wasted — 1002 实锤: dialog did not move until split). wizard_run.py gates on the literal string `'"checked":true'` in the verify output and hard-exits otherwise.

Button-finding iron rule: never match button text via XPath text() or el.textContent — a browser translate extension wraps text in `<span data-component="translate">`, making the text node no longer a direct child of the button. Recipe (all wizard files): iterate 'span, a, button' (or all '*'), keep elements having their OWN text node (childNodes nodeType===3, trimmed === target word), then `el.closest('button') || el.closest('a')` for the real button, check visibility via `offsetParent !== null`, `scrollIntoView({block:'center'})` then click. Take the deepest hit when multiple wrappers share the wording. Chrome-MCP trusted click on a data-attribute-marked element is more reliable than eval .click() for some Vue listeners.

mp console pre-renders hidden dialogs (display:none nodes still in DOM) — querySelector returns a pile of invisible ones. Visibility criteria: `el.offsetParent !== null` (basic); wizard_run.py visDialog additionally requires computed style display!=none, visibility!=hidden, rect width>60 and height>20, candidate selectors `.weui-dialog, .dialog, .modal, [class*=dialog], [class*=modal], [class*=Dialog]`, optionally anchored by text (e.g. '提交审核的相关须知'), with a fallback: any visible div containing the anchor text with total text length < 3000. submit_review_0911.py JS_DUMP_DIALOG dedupes by className and slices text to 200 chars, also reports the first checkbox state.

driver.py channel design: a dedicated Chrome instance on local port 9336 with its own profile E:\AI-Station\data\state\mp_qr_profile — created because the MCP shared browser was fought over by research legs (hide/show + restarts destroyed tabs, QR page could not survive). attach_or_launch(): ChromiumOptions().set_local_port(9336).set_user_data_path(PROFILE), arguments `--window-size=1100,860` and `--no-first-run`, headful by default (二维码须显示到桌面 — QR must be visible on the user's desktop for scanning); ChromiumPage attaches if running, launches otherwise. State machine for the cancel-logout chain: QR_WAIT / LOGGED_IN / ACT_<n> / RESTORED / NEED_USER / ERROR; every step JSON-printed and persisted to state.json next to the script. 红线: 绝不动控制台其他任何按钮. QR freshness check: html contains neither 已失效 nor 点击刷新; stale -> reload root once. Login-timeout shell detection: '登录超时' in html -> back to QR_WAIT.

live_token() pattern (watch_category.py, used by wizard_run.py/submit_v080.py): extract token via regex `token=(\d{8,})` from the current tab URL; if missing, navigate to https://mp.weixin.qq.com/, sleep 5, re-regex URL + first 30000 chars of html; still empty -> report login_wall with note 须扫码召唤（勿自动重发企微，12h 一条）. watch_review_browser.py harvests token by splitting the logged-tab URL on 'token=' and '&' to open a fresh getcodepage tab.

gotchas.symptom: Category watcher silently stopped for a whole day; no GREEN notification ever fired even after category approval
gotchas.root_cause: Session-level cron (id 890da29a) died with its session — .claude scheduled_tasks.json verified empty; session crons are not durable across session death
gotchas.fix: Move all must-run watchers to OS-level schtasks (QianwenCatWatch PT3H, QianwenReviewWatch PT2H) per the 指令必须严格持久执行 doctrine; session cron only as reminder layer

gotchas.symptom: API audit-status monitor plan dead on arrival: GET /wxa/get_latest_auditstatus returns errcode 86000 "should be called only from third party" for the self-developed appid; POST to it returns 43001
gotchas.root_cause: Endpoint is third-party-platform-only; a self-developed miniprogram's own client_credential token can never call it
gotchas.fix: Read audit status from the console UI instead: attach 9336 Chrome, reload the getcodepage tab, own-text-node-find the target version row, classify by status words; mobile push (公众平台安全助手) reaches the admin first anyway

gotchas.symptom: watch_category_api.py network leg dies with SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL against api.weixin.qq.com when using curl_cffi impersonation
gotchas.root_cause: curl_cffi browser-impersonate TLS fingerprint gets cut by the api.weixin.qq.com endpoint
gotchas.fix: Use plain `requests` with explicit timeouts (20s) for all api.weixin.qq.com calls; any exception is downgraded to verdict ERROR (silent retry next round)

gotchas.symptom: Checkbox clicked three times in a loop ends up UNCHECKED; or checkbox+下一步 in one eval leaves the dialog frozen
gotchas.root_cause: Both the input and its label are bound to toggle — one logical click registers as multiple toggles; and same-eval chained clicks miss the Vue digest cycle so the second click is wasted (1002 实锤)
gotchas.fix: Click the checkbox exactly once in eval #1; verify `.checked === true` in a separate eval #2 (hard-exit if false); click 下一步 in eval #3. wizard_run.py literally gates on the string '"checked":true' in the verify JSON

gotchas.symptom: Version-description textarea assignment `ta.value = txt` shows no effect: counter stays put, submitted form carries the old value
gotchas.root_cause: Vue v-model listens for input events; setting the value property directly never fires them
gotchas.fix: Native prototype setter + event dispatch: `Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set` -> `setter.call(ta, txt)` -> dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})) and ('change'); proof of ingestion = counter text (e.g. 184/200) equals read-back ta.value.length

gotchas.symptom: Description text poured into a hidden JSON draft-slot textarea; submit then hard-stalls
gotchas.root_cause: mp console pages keep hidden JSON textareas (form draft storage); `querySelector('textarea')` first-match can hit the slot
gotchas.fix: Anchor the real textarea by placeholder content (ICP form: placeholder contains '请根据实际情况填写'; wizard form: placeholder contains '功能' OR value.length>20 OR maxLength===200)

gotchas.symptom: XPath text() or el.textContent button matching goes blind; matched span clicks do nothing
gotchas.root_cause: Browser translate extension wraps button text in `<span data-component="translate">`, detaching the text node from the button
gotchas.fix: Own-text-node finder: iterate span/a/button(/div/*), keep elements with their own trimmed text node equal to the word, `closest('button')||closest('a')` to the real button, visibility via offsetParent!==null, scrollIntoView then click; prefer deepest hit; Chrome-MCP trusted click beats eval .click() for Vue listeners

gotchas.symptom: Dialog handler grabs a pile of invisible dialogs; actions fire against hidden pre-rendered nodes
gotchas.root_cause: mp console pre-renders hidden dialogs (display:none still in DOM)
gotchas.fix: Visibility gate `el.offsetParent !== null`; stricter: computed display/visibility + bounding rect width>60 height>20, plus anchor text (e.g. '提交审核的相关须知') and text-length sanity (<3000 chars)

gotchas.symptom: Ancestor-traversal button targeting on the version page clicked the WRONG version's button (选为体验版 incident: hit 0.4.2 historical row, popped a dangerous switch dialog)
gotchas.root_cause: Rows share identical button wording; closest()-upward search from an arbitrary button is not version-scoped
gotchas.fix: Anchor by the target version NUMBER text inside its `.code_version_log` block first, then search for the button scoped to that block; same pattern used for the 提交审核 row (own-text-node version match -> walk up <=8 parents to the row containing the primary button)

gotchas.symptom: Review watcher reads NO_ROW on a freshly reloaded getcodepage tab (body.innerText nearly empty)
gotchas.root_cause: Zombie tab cold-renders slowly after location.reload() in the long-lived 9336 browser
gotchas.fix: sleep 9 after reload; if still NO_ROW with hasBody false, sleep 5 and re-run the identical read once before concluding

gotchas.symptom: Scheduled watcher would have auto-fired the irreversible release (全量发布) on APPROVED
gotchas.root_cause: Release/publish is an outward irreversible action; an unattended watcher must never trigger it
gotchas.fix: Watchers only notify + write flag files (mp_review_approved.flag / mp_review_rejected.flag / mp_category_green.flag); the six-step release checklist is executed verbatim by a session leg; same discipline for category GREEN (re-submit left to session leg doing BOOT-SIM + submit_audit)

gotchas.symptom: After switching vpay env=1->0, real phones could not pull up payment
gotchas.root_cause: 1009 incident: env switched to 0 and deployed BEFORE the item-publish/prereq chain completed
gotchas.fix: 防呆闸 in release step 4: env=0 requires a prior `echo "执行人/日期" > data/state/VPAY_PROD_LIVE.flag` (human-attributed go signal) before the virtual_pay.secret -> qw_tcb_prep.py -> update_envparams.js chain runs

gotchas.symptom: A scheduled watcher could pop a headful Chrome window on the user's desktop at 3am
gotchas.root_cause: DrissionPage ChromiumPage with options would launch a new headful Chrome if 9336 is not running (QR visibility requirement makes the channel headful by design)
gotchas.fix: Socket-probe first: connect_ex to 127.0.0.1:9336 with 1.5s timeout; port down -> verdict SKIP, exit 0 silently; only attach (set_local_port, never set_user_data_path cold start) when the channel is alive

gotchas.symptom: Submit wizard could run against the wrong miniprogram account (multiple accounts share the 9336 console)
gotchas.root_cause: Console session can hold several accounts; wrong-appid submit = disaster
gotchas.fix: APPID_MISMATCH guard: assert the target appid string (wx5cee1574ce45819b) appears in the getcodepage tab HTML before any stage; mismatch -> print APPID_MISMATCH（错号灾难防线）+ exit 1

gotchas.symptom: Expedited review wanted after submission — no way to add it
gotchas.root_cause: 加急 is selectable ONLY on the get_class main form at submit time; post-submit it cannot be changed or added; the free expedite quota is consumed at that checkbox
gotchas.fix: Decide expedite BEFORE clicking the submit <a class="btn btn_primary">; default posture in all recorded submits is 不加急 (and API submit_audit path never expedites)

gotchas.symptom: MCP shared-browser automation of the console kept losing the QR/login tabs (hide/show + restarts destroyed tabs)
gotchas.root_cause: Multiple research legs contend for the one MCP-managed browser
gotchas.fix: Dedicated Chrome channel: port 9336 + profile E:\AI-Station\data\state\mp_qr_profile via ChromiumOptions, headful (QR must be visible on desktop), attach-or-launch; 9336 becomes the console's single legal port (纪律: 9336 是控制台唯一合法口)

gotchas.symptom: Category browser watcher failed after console relogin (hardcoded token)
gotchas.root_cause: Session relogin invalidates the old token — stale hardcoded token was the root cause of missed watch rounds (1006 fix)
gotchas.fix: live_token(): regex token=(\d{8,}) from live tab URL; fallback navigate to mp root, sleep 5, re-regex URL + first 30000 html chars; still none -> honest login_wall report + 扫码召唤 (WeCom QR-summon throttled to 1 per 12h)

gotchas.symptom: Submit-button click missed even after FIND_BTN located it
gotchas.root_cause: The submit control is an `<a class="btn btn_primary"> anchor, not a `<button>`; selectors limited to button tag never match
gotchas.fix: Search `a.btn_primary, a.btn.btn_primary, .btn_primary` filtered by text containing 提交审核 AND visible; scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) in eval #1, actual click in eval #2 (separate evals again); terminal proof = body contains 已提交审核/提交成功/审核中

recipes.name: Submit-review wizard, one-piece stage chain (wizard_run.py pattern)
recipes.steps: Preconditions: 9336 Chrome alive + logged-in tab (token in URL), appid verified on page. Run stages IN ORDER, each is one process: `python wizard_run.py nav` (getcodepage?lang=zh_CN&token=<tok>, sleep 6, dump .code_version_log blocks) -> `step1` (in the target version block click 提交审核 via findBtn; then click checkbox once) -> `step1b` (separate eval verify checked==true, hard-exit if not; click 下一步 inside the visible dialog anchored '提交审核的相关须知') -> `step2` (click 继续提交, sleep 5, print URL — get_class param means form reached) -> `form` (dump textareas with placeholder/len/maxLength + radios + 订单中心 labels; human reviews BEFORE filling) -> `fill` (urllib.parse.quote the description; JS: decodeURIComponent -> pick real textarea (placeholder 功能|len>20|maxLength 200) -> HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype value setter -> dispatch input+change bubbles -> report len/head/tail) -> `commit` (pre-commit snapshot desc_len + checked radios; find visible a.btn_primary containing 提交审核; scrollIntoView eval; click in separate eval; sleep 5; assert body hits 已提交审核/提交成功/审核中; screenshot). Tab pinning at startup: prefer get_class tab, else getcodepage.

recipes.name: Staged 0.9.12 wizard with human gate (submit_review_0911.py + finish_review_0912.py)
recipes.steps: `python submit_review_0911.py recon` — zero-click: appid check, live 体验版 read, target-row dump, dialog dump, screenshot review_0911_recon.png -> `open` — click 提交审核 (own-text-node '0.9.12' -> walk up <=8 parents -> button.weui-desktop-btn_primary), screenshot -> `step1` — checkbox click eval + verify eval + 下一步 click -> `step2` — click 继续提交, dump form skeleton (NO filling). RED LINE from docstring: fill/submit run as separate stages only after a human has reviewed the fill DOM dump. After manual fill+submit: `python finish_review_0912.py` — in the get_class tab click the success-dialog 确定 (innerText==='确定' && offsetParent!==null -> closest button/a), then reload the getcodepage tab (location.reload(), sleep 8) and verify body contains '0.9.12' + '审核中', extract the version row (own-text-node walk-up, 20<len<600), screenshot review_0912_submitted.png.

recipes.steps: Browser leg `watch_review_browser.py`: socket connect_ex 127.0.0.1:9336 (1.5s) — down -> SKIP; attach ChromiumOptions().set_local_port(9336) only; find getcodepage tab, else harvest token from any mp.weixin.qq.com tab and page.new_tab(GETCODE?token=...&lang=zh_CN) sleep 6; run_js location.reload() + sleep 9; own-text-node find WATCH_VER row (walk up <=8 parents, 10<len<600); auth check first (登录超时/扫码登录 -> AUTH_EXPIRED); classify: 审核通过|已发布|线上版本 -> APPROVED, 审核不通过|驳回|审核失败 -> REJECTED, else PENDING; NO_ROW without body -> sleep 5 re-read once; print single-line JSON. recipes.name: Flip-only notify + flag state machine (shared watcher skeleton)
recipes.steps: 1) run probe via subprocess.run([sys.executable, WATCH], capture_output=True, timeout=120, creationflags=CREATE_NO_WINDOW); 2) json.loads(stdout.splitlines()[-1]) with fallback {verdict: ERROR, detail: tail-or-exitcode}; 3) prev = json.load(STATE).get('last_verdict','') (missing file -> ''); 4) act only on transition: desired terminal state -> write flag file (json {at ISO8601 CST (+08:00), row/categories}) + notify(title, body) via subprocess python tools/notify_wecom.py (timeout 60, notify failure logged, never fatal); anomaly -> distinct verdict so recovery can re-notify; 5) always persist {last_verdict, at} back to STATE; 6) append one log line per run (timestamped, utf-8).

recipes.name: Vue-controlled textarea fill (native setter)
recipes.steps: In page JS: pick the real textarea (placeholder anchor, e.g. contains '功能' for the review form / '请根据实际情况填写' for ICP form; reject hidden JSON slots) -> `var setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(ta, txt);` -> `ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true}));` -> proof: counter element text (184/200) must equal ta.value.length; pass non-ASCII text by urllib.parse.quote on the Python side + decodeURIComponent in JS.

recipes.name: Own-text-node real-button finder (FIND_BTN)
recipes.steps: function findBtn(doc, depth, word): querySelectorAll('span, a, button, div'); for each el concatenate its OWN child text nodes (nodeType===3); trimmed === word -> real = el.closest('button') || el.closest('a'); recurse into same-document iframes up to depth 3. Visibility = offsetParent !== null (optionally computed style + rect > 60x20). Click protocol: scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) in one eval, click in the NEXT eval; never XPath text(); never chain checkbox+button in one eval.

Zombie-tab discipline: reuse existing getcodepage/get_class tabs across stages so wizard state survives; screenshot every stage into WeAppForge/filing/. Iron rule: never touch any other console button.
